title: Monero GUI wallet files
whyItMatters: Monero wallet .keys files hold the spend key protected only by the wallet password. A copy lets someone try passwords offline and take the funds.
source: Monero GUI Windows installer creates and uses Documents/Monero/wallets as the default wallet folder: https://github.com/monero-project/monero-gui/blob/master/installers/windows/Monero.iss
notes: Default location created by the installer. The wizard lets the user pick another folder, so a wallet saved elsewhere is only caught by the personal-folder rules. App settings and logs live in %APPDATA% monero-gui, not here.

cleanup.exportFirst: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup: the 25-word seed or the address, view key and spend key for each wallet.
steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup before removing anything.
Open Monero GUI and restore one wallet from its seed or keys to prove the backup works.
Uninstall Monero GUI from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the wallet folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Wallet key files cannot be restored without the seed or keys; deleting them loses access to the funds.
cleanup.source: Monero, Restoring a wallet from private keys: https://www.getmonero.org/resources/user-guides/restore_from_keys.html
